newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: PacDun says chairman Gough to retire.
newsitem.headline: PacDun says chairman Gough to retire.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Pacific Dunlop Ltd said on Friday that John Gough would retire as chairman and as a director in August this year, to be replaced by deputy chairman John Ralph.
Gough was managing director of the Melbourne-based bluechip company from 1980 to 1987 and joined the group in 1970.
"The restructuring over the past two years and the improvement now beginning to occur gives me great confidence about the strength and future of the company," he said.
"The new management team, led by Mr Chadwick, will provide the leadership required over the coming years which I expect to be an important growth period for the company."
